$reason: A button whose start tag holds a line comment, `// the user's way back`, which Angular 22 reads as trivia inside the tag, in a component that declares neither name input. The comment holds an apostrophe and nothing after it closes one. Blanked, the tag reads as the parser reads it; left in the text, as a pattern for `<!--` leaves it, the apostrophe opens a quote that never closes, the scan finds no tag where the button starts, and the button fails point 1 as a tag the scan never found.
